question: The true MPI-off/OpenBLAS comparator reproduced the identical OpenBLAS frame offsets and `fdiv d2, d0, d1` instruction below ZHEGVX, excluding MPI initialization as a necessary cause, while the failed LLDB attempt retained no operands or status register. May a bounded class-separated non-MPI sequence identify whether the matching first trap is divide-by-zero, invalid, or overflow?

options.summary: Recommended: build and invoke non-MPI/OpenBLAS C48 comparators with one trap class enabled at a time, in the order divide-by-zero, invalid, then overflow, stopping immediately when a run reproduces the exact prior OpenBLAS frame and instruction.
options.consequence: Use unchanged QE 7.2 source, exact C48 input, exact Si.upf, pinned OpenBLAS 0.3.33, MPI off, OpenMP off, and otherwise identical Debug configuration. Create separate isolated build and run roots carrying the class names under ~/projects/q-e-diagnostics and ~/projects/ksdft2effmass-runs with timestamp 20260921T010351Z. Permit at most one invocation per class and at most three invocations total, each with OMP_NUM_THREADS=1, a two-minute wall limit, 500 MB observed resident-memory envelope, and 250 MB run-workspace envelope. Test `-ffpe-trap=zero` first; if and only if it does not reproduce the exact OpenBLAS `ztrsv_CUN+388` / instruction `0x1e611802` trap, test `-ffpe-trap=invalid`; if and only if that also does not reproduce it, test `-ffpe-trap=overflow`. Stop at the first exact match or after all three. Allow up to 30 minutes, 8 GiB memory, and 4 GiB storage per build, using at most eight local jobs. Retain identities, linkage, streams, timing, signal, crash report, and cross-run comparison. No retry, combined trap set, underflow trap, MPI-enabled run, debugger, dependency installation or production adoption, setting promotion, successor activation, or network, remote, cluster, or cloud use is authorized. A matching class identifies only the first enabled trap at this operation; it does not establish mathematical or observable impact.
